title: Granola raises $125M, hits $1.5B valuation as it expands from meeting notetaker to enterprise AI app

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Granola just hit a $1.5B valuation after a $125M funding round — and it’s not just another startup.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This move shows how AI note-taking is evolving into a serious enterprise tool.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Granola started as a meeting notetaker but now builds AI apps for businesses.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Its newest feature uses AI to auto-summarize meetings and generate action items.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects teams across industries, streamlining workflows and boosting productivity.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The takeaway? AI tools are no longer just handy — they’re reshaping how companies operate.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What’s next for Granola? Follow along to see how it changes the game.
